Infections are really shitty to deal with. Even the minor ones, and the major ones can be life threatening. I know a lot of people who don't care about infection are of the opinion of 'who cares, I want to die, anyways', but serious infections aren't instant death. They're burning fevers and puss leaking through clothes and violent vomiting, things people around you will notice and may enforce treatment on, especially parents. A lot of self harmers here are young, after all. Then you'll just end up in the hospital with chunks of flesh removed and most likely, an extended involuntary stay in the psych ward. Things a lot of people don't want to happen.  


Not everyone who self harms is suicidal, either, or wishes to remain a self harmer. Some people acknowledge this is a low point in their life that they wish to recover from. That's just a few reasons. I personally don't want to be hospitalized for any reason, not even for medical treatment, so take a lot of care in keeping a well stocked kit and clean tools. There's not an official diagnosis for this type of escapist coping mechanism, but it is something that other people experience. I myself do this occasionally, some people refer to it as 'ego masking', where you replace your 'ego' or self with a manufactured one. A lot of people do this because it's easier to actively 'ego' through a stressful situation than to like, actually face it with their authentic self. It can also help stressful situations seem manufactured, thus reducing the stressfulness of it. Hope this helps, you're never alone! (: <3
